_comment: Manifest for scripts/qa-parity.py — the relational QA layer. Each set declares a consistency contract that spans files; the checker fails when any location drifts. When a fix adds a member to one list, add it HERE too — the checker then forces the sweep of every sibling list. Region anchors are literal substrings; if a heading is reworded, update the anchor here in the same commit.

member_sets._comment: The coach mandatory-field parity contract (CLAUDE.md cross-file-contracts): Step 0.8 coach-complete list, Step 0.9a confirmation pass, gatekeeper Coach Output Check presence-check, and coach-output.md template slots must all carry every member. 'Hiring Manager's Name' is deliberately NOT a member — it is research-derived and optional (may be genuinely unfindable), mandatory nowhere.

Step 0b's delegated per-page fetch must capture every property any downstream step (0.5 routing, 0.8 coach-complete, 0.9a writeback) reads. Two confirmed production-failure families live here: JD Body/WIWTR (2026-07-13 fix) and the three coach-complete fields (2026-07-13 calibration finding).

2026-07-23 fix: the adapter's archived/in-trash exclusion rule and role-prioritizer's scores-only caller contract cite each other; both files must keep naming the rule. Anchors are literal substrings.

defined_terms._comment: 2026-07-14: renamed from halt-before-export policy per the user's direct instruction — cap exhaustion delivers flagged output, never nothing. Both pipelines cite this exact name; definition lives in orchestrator-queue.md Absolute Constraints.

2026-07-14: the letter-writer receives exactly three content inputs (final CV, Role emphasis, WIWTR) plus identity and routing tokens. Cited across both pipelines, writer-craft, gatekeeper-checks, recruiter-reviewer, career-coach, qa-plugin. Canonical statement lives in new-application Step 5 and the agent file.

context_sets._comment: Every gatekeeper option=cover-letter spawn paragraph must carry CAREER_DATA and Strategy (the word-count-ceiling governor a bare respawn historically dropped), unless it explicitly restates by reference. min_sites guards against the trigger phrase being reworded out of existence, which would silently disable this check.
Every gatekeeper option=cv spawn paragraph must carry CAREER_DATA and the resolved CV Type (single-resolution-point contract).

2026-07-14: every subagent spawn in the New Application and Edit pipelines passes gap_handling_mode alongside CAREER_DATA (universal spawn parameter). Trigger = the literal CAREER_DATA restatement every spawn site carries; any paragraph restating it must also carry the mode token. min_sites guards against the pairing being reworded out of existence.

pipe_closure._comment: Every $PIPE/$RUN_PIPE/$QUEUE_PIPE file token a pipeline doc mentions must have at least one occurrence on a line with a write marker in that same doc — otherwise the doc reads a file nothing writes (the cv-final.md failure family, 2026-07-13). Exceptions list legitimate cross-file handoffs with the producing file named in the reason.
